claims.originating_goal: Correct the live-weather response evidence semantics so non-deterministic source observations are not mislabeled as deterministic execution or same-execution reconstruction in the public Ecosystem Chat.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head validation, merge, deployment, and public observation confirms weather responses carry source-observation evidence without deterministic/model misclassification.
collision_boundaries: Do not alter the weather provider path or geolocation policy.
Do not create a second conversational runtime.
Do not claim source observation is deterministic execution.
Do not claim same-execution reconstruction for changing external weather data.
claims.next_task_after_release: Return to canonical public iPhone weather observation; then repair only the first exact runtime defect if one remains.
